cases.constructed: Offline verifier accepts credential revoked after last status refresh
cases.proposed_evidence: Exercise bounded stale status and reconnect paths; inspect maximum propagation delay and offline acceptance policy; no per-presentation callback. Part 3 p54 explicitly recognizes tension. Distinguish offline availability from freshness.

cases.constructed: Compromised holder recovers without original device or technical expertise
cases.proposed_evidence: Exercise accessible expedited replacement, proofing-window boundaries, adversarial recovery and old-credential invalidation; check actual time without usable identity and lawful physical alternative (SEDI-01). Do not assume re-binding alone revokes old credential.

cases.constructed: Operator supplies allowed reason code without substantiating actual ground
cases.proposed_evidence: Inspect authorization, evidence supporting ground, audit and disputed-revocation handling. Negative API tests cannot establish factual justification; guide explicitly acknowledges this limitation.

cases.constructed: Planned rotation and emergency key compromise produce different validity outcomes
cases.proposed_evidence: Test planned overlap and verifier trust-store updates separately from emergency revocation, notification and reissuance. Exercise incident plan and measure affected holders' interruption; do not infer emergency validity from planned rotation requirement.

cases.constructed: Holder migrates credential between conforming wallets; old wallet remains accessible
cases.proposed_evidence: Test preserved binding, unauthorized copy resistance, failed import and recovery; distinguish portability from compromise replacement. Guide does not by itself establish old-wallet retirement semantics.

cases.constructed: Normal recovery succeeds in a controlled fixture but operational coverage is missing
cases.proposed_evidence: Compare recovery completion, accessibility and reproofing evidence across representative contexts; fixture success is not population-level continuity assurance.

limitations: No deployment, actual incident, propagation measurements or recovery outcomes examined.
No independent legal conclusion, risk scores or verified guardrail.
Part 3 p54 explicitly documents offline/status tension; proposed checks do not resolve the design decision.
Separate documentary tranche; not included in SEDI-01 composed runner.
